title: l1qw.26a: group invitation replay ledger becomes per-inviter 32-entry nonce ring (RAM-only)
description: Child of l1qw.26 (spec 18.8.2, R-12-064): replace the unbounded per-group identity-hash nonce dict (python/src/lichen/group_membership.py / groups_collection.py:199-214,504-509) with the spec-mandated per-inviter nonce ring buffer of 32 entries, RAM-only. Behavior change is spec-directed (old nonces eventually forgotten; bounded memory). Keep the existing rejection semantics for a nonce still resident in the ring; update/extend the groups_membership tests for ring eviction semantics (34th distinct nonce evicts the oldest; evicted nonce becomes acceptable again ONLY as the spec's ring dictates). Do NOT touch the envelope format in this slice (that is .26b).
close_reason: Re-close (store revert; folded into .26.2.2 per recorded rescoping — ring implemented in the COSE resource path, tested). See prior close reason.
